text:
olga_csm: Heads up — FableTech submitted an intake for a production ensemble. They want a 14B domain-adapted reranker + a 60B conversational summarizer. Requirements: EU-North residency, Azure Dedicated HSM, strict PII removal options, and a cost estimate before renewal (month 6). Need an intake owner and a fast feasibility note.
ryan_ml_eng: Quick checks: will both models run inside their VPC with Redwood Private? Do they want model artifact escrow or direct artifact hosting?
olga_csm: Confirmed: Redwood Private in eu-north-1 (customer VNet). They want us to host model artifacts in their storage (they prefer model artifacts in customer-managed blob storage) and want model signing and attestation. Peak load: reranker ~300 qps daytime, summarizer ~40 qps but large contexts (avg 2k tokens).
ryan_ml_eng: Notes: 14B reranker int8/4bit should hit low latency for 300 qps if we use batching + prefix caching. 60B summarizer with 2k context — probably need multi-GPU (tensor parallel) or QK cache sharding; also consider offloading KV cache to NVMe for cost tradeoffs.
sam_security: Security checklist: 1) Azure Dedicated HSM integration + customer key policy (no key export). 2) PII removal preprocessor or redaction step (customer may opt in). 3) No plaintext request logs; only hashed request IDs and telemetry. 4) Data residency enforcement -> egress rules to eu-north-1 only. Also request their retention policy and legal signoff for PHI.
beth_infra: From infra: We can spin a dedicated node pool in their VNet. Need their subscription role for Managed Identity and a service principal. Also: will need NSG rules and SRE runbook for failover.
devex_maya: For enablement: I'll prepare a short code sample and runbook. Ask customer to upload a 100-transcript eval corpus + safety labels (what to redact). Also propose a 30-minute technical onboarding call.
olga_csm: They've dropped a link to shared blob with sample transcripts and a readme (mentions some credit card numbers and names). Also asked whether we can do automated redaction before ingestion.
sam_security: We should offer two options: 1) client-side de-id (preferred) or 2) our redaction pipeline in their VNet (with strict audit and delete-after-processing). Need legal to sign off on deletion cadence.
ryan_ml_eng: Action list I can take: - Run local perf tests for 14B reranker with 128/256 token contexts - Prototype 60B summarizer with 2048 context and measure memory footprint across 4xA100s - Design traffic split: reranker low-latency path, summarizer batched path - Canary plan: start with 5 qps reranker and 2 qps summarizer for 72h then ramp if p50/p95 stable
devex_maya: SDK snippet for in-VNet call (draft):
```bash
# in-VNet example to Private endpoint (eu-north-1)
curl -X POST https://private-eu-north1.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"model":"summarizer-60b-quant","input":"<conversation>"}'
```
deploy-bot: Created onboarding checklist: [ ] infra creds collected, [ ] HSM keys provisioned, [ ] artifact access validated, [ ] redaction option chosen, [ ] canary config created, [ ] dashboards linked. Link: /ops/onboard/1775001234
beth_infra: Also need to confirm their HSM vendor (they use Azure Dedicated HSM) and whether we can integrate with their Managed Identity for signing.
olga_csm: Timeline proposal: day 0 intake accepted, day 2 security + legal signoff, day 8 infra access + HSM keys, day 12 canary start. Customer asked for p50 <200ms for reranker and p95 <800ms for summarizer; they said renewal conversation at month 6 will hinge on cost per 1k and recall/precision on their eval set.
ryan_ml_eng: If canary misses p95 target, recommend: tune batching, increase GPU count, or propose a Dedicated commit to reduce unit cost. Also will run quality evals against their annotated prompts to ensure no regression.
sam_security: I'll coordinate with legal on PHI/PII clauses and draft a short attestation template for HSM integration. Also require model artifact signing + verify checksums before deploy.
devex_maya: I'll prepare slides + quickstart repo and schedule the tech call. Requesting their security contact and ops contact for calendar invite.
olga_csm: Assigning owners: @ryan_ml_eng (benchmarks + canary), @beth_infra (VNet + HSM wiring), @sam_security (security/legal), @devex_maya (runbook & enablement). I'll send kickoff invite for tomorrow 09:30 CET. Update thread after call. :white_check_mark:
